experimental_design.evidence: inferred: We compared hESCs with their neuronal counterpart to quantify differences in the expression of cold-shock domain containing proteins.

technology_type.evidence: For the comparison between control and CSDE1 KD H9 hESCs (Supplementary Table 3 and Supplementary Data 3), we performed label-free quantitative (LFQ) proteomics.
For the comparison between H9 hESCs and their differentiated neuronal counterparts (Supplementary Table 1 and Supplementary Data 1), we performed tandem mass tag (TMT) proteomics.
